detail.body:
## Overview

`/v1/systemone` on hybrid (Mamba/linear-attention) models prefilled the state once per question, because reads that start together cannot reuse each other's recurrent state. This sends one request for the tokens all questions share before the reads, so each question only prefills its own text. Related: #59299 (endpoint), #60677.

## Claims

- Hybrid model, prefix caching on, 2+ questions: 4 questions 25.3 → 8.1 s, 16 questions 106.5 → 12.0 s, 64 questions 419 → 28.7 s (p50, 2k-token state). Prefix-cache hit rate 0.37 → 0.94.
- Throughput with 8 questions of a 1k-token state per request: 0.027 → 0.17 req/s.
- A single question is unchanged (6.4 s). Answers are unchanged (label accuracy on 120 synthetic tickets identical: 0.90 / 0.67 / 1.00).
- No change on attention-only models or with prefix caching off: the warm-up is skipped.

## Validation

Qwen3.8-27B (Qwen3_5 hybrid, 4-bit, MTP 3) on gfx1151 (Radeon 8060S), nightly `0.31.1rc1.dev273` (`2eb491e18b`), `--enable-prefix-caching --mamba-cache-mode align --prefix-match-unit 32 --logprobs-mode raw_logprobs`. Same seed and prompts in both columns, p50 latency of a `/v1/systemone` call, state of 2048 tokens:

| questions | main | this PR |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 6.4 s | 6.4 s |
| 4 | 25.3 s | 8.1 s |
| 16 | 106.5 s | 12.0 s |
| 64 | 419.1 s | 28.7 s |

| config | 4 q | 16 q | 64 q |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--enable-mamba-shared-prefix-checkpoint`, main → PR | 14.1 → 8.1 s | 36.4 → 11.9 s | 126.3 → 28.7 s |
| MTP off, `--prefix-match-unit 16`, main → PR | 11.6 → 7.2 s | 42.8 → 10.0 s | n/a → 21.2 s |

The warm-up alone gives the full gain; the checkpoint flag is not needed with it (8.1 / 12.0 / 28.7 s with and without).

Attention-only model (Qwen3-0.6B, prefix caching on), warm-up forced on for the test: 4 questions 0.375 → 0.399 s, 16 questions 0.538 → 0.564 s, since the blocks are already shared within a step there. That is why the warm-up is limited to hybrid models.

Tests:

```bash
pytest tests/entrypoints/generate/structured_decisions/test_strategies.py
```

17 passed. The new test checks the order and content of the engine calls (warm-up request first, with `cache_salt`, then the reads, all starting with the same ids) and the four cases where it is skipped (attention-only, prefix caching off, one question, short state).

Reproduction: a client posting `/v1/systemone` with a fresh synthetic state of 2048 tokens and N filler `choice` questions, after one 2-question warm-up call; p50 over 3 repetitions per N, same seed for both columns; server flags as above.

## Details

- The warm-up is a `max_tokens=1` request on the longest common token prefix of the question prompts (at least 128 tokens), sent with the request's `cache_salt`, priority, LoRA and trace headers. Its prompt-end checkpoint lands where the questions diverge, so each read resumes there and only prefills its question.
- Cost: one extra scheduler round trip when the state is cold. Skipped for one question, a prefix under 128 tokens, prefix caching off, or a non-hybrid model.
- Not covered: Mamba state kept by connectors, and models other than the one above. The change is in `NextTokenStrategy`, so the diffusion strategy inherits it; it was not run.
- Potential rebase conflicts with the other open PRs touching `structured_decisions/strategies.py` (#60676, #60713, #60288).

---

+def test_common_prefix_len():
+    assert common_prefix_len([[1, 2, 3, 4], [1, 2, 3, 9, 9], [1, 2, 3]]) == 3
+    assert common_prefix_len([[1, 2], [3, 4]]) == 0
+    assert common_prefix_len([[1, 2, 3]]) == 3
+
+
+def two_choice_questions():
+    return {
+        "team": {
+            "type": "choice",
+            "instructions": "Which team does the message name?",
+            "criteria": {"billing": "payments", "shipping": "deliveries"},
+        },
+        "lang": {
+            "type": "choice",
+            "instructions": "Which language does the message name?",
+            "criteria": {"English": "English text", "French": "French text"},
+        },
+    }
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "hybrid,prefix_caching,n_questions,state_words,warms",
+    [
+        (True, True, 2, 300, True),
+        (False, True, 2, 300, False),
+        (True, False, 2, 300, False),
+        (True, True, 1, 300, False),
+        (True, True, 2, 5, False),
+    ],
+    ids=["warm", "attention_only", "no_prefix_caching", "one_question", "short_state"],
+)
+async def test_state_is_prefilled_once_before_the_reads(
+    serving_and_engine,
+    monkeypatch,
+    hybrid,
+    prefix_caching,
+    n_questions,
+    state_words,
+    warms,
+):
+    serving, engine = serving_and_engine
+    monkeypatch.setattr(ModelConfig, "is_hybrid", property(lambda self: hybrid))
+    engine.vllm_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(enable_prefix_caching=prefix_caching)
+    )
+    questions = dict(list(two_choice_questions().items())[:n_questions])
+    request = StructuredDecisionRequest(
+        state="word " * state_words, questions=questions, cache_salt="tenant"
+    )
+    response = await serving.create_decision(request)
+    assert isinstance(response, StructuredDecisionResponse)
+    calls = engine.generate.call_args_list
+    assert len(calls) == n_questions + warms
+    if not warms:
+        return
+    warm, reads = calls[0], calls[1:]
+    assert warm.args[2].endswith("-prefix")
+    assert warm.args[1].max_tokens == 1
+    assert warm.args[0]["cache_salt"] == "tenant"
+    warm_ids = warm.args[0]["prompt_token_ids"]
+    assert len(warm_ids) >= state_words
+    for read in reads:
+        read_ids = read.args[0]["prompt_token_ids"]
+        assert read_ids[: len(warm_ids)] == warm_ids
+        assert read.args[1].logprob_token_ids
+

+# Fewer shared tokens are not worth an extra round trip before the reads.
+MIN_WARM_PREFIX_TOKENS = 128
+
+
+def common_prefix_len(prompts: Sequence[Sequence[int]]) -> int:
+    """The number of leading token ids that every prompt starts with."""
+    shortest = min(prompts, key=len)
+    for i, token_id in enumerate(shortest):
+        if any(p[i] != token_id for p in prompts):
+            return i
+    return len(shortest)
+
 
 @dataclass
 class ReadContext:
@@ -202,6 +214,44 @@ async def _render(
         ).token_ids
         return engine_input, list(prompt_ids or [])
 
+    async def _warm_shared_prefix(
+        self,
+        prompts: Sequence[Sequence[int]],
+        request_id: str,
+        *,
+        lora_request: LoRARequest | None,
+        priority: int,
+        cache_salt: str | None,
+        trace_headers: Mapping[str, str] | None,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Prefill the tokens every question starts with, before the reads.
+
+        The reads share the state only through the prefix cache. Reads that
+        start together cannot reuse each other's recurrent state, so on hybrid
+        models each of them would prefill the state again. Attention-only
+        models share the blocks within a step and skip this.
+        """
+        engine_client = self.context.engine_client
+        if (
+            len(prompts) < 2
+            or not engine_client.model_config.is_hybrid
+            or not engine_client.vllm_config.cache_config.enable_prefix_caching
+        ):
+            return
+        shared = common_prefix_len(prompts)
+        if shared < MIN_WARM_PREFIX_TOKENS:
+            return
+        generator = engine_client.generate(
+            tokens_input(list(prompts[0][:shared]), cache_salt=cache_salt),
+            SamplingParams(max_tokens=1, temperature=0.0),
+            f"{request_id}-prefix",
+            lora_request=lora_request,
+            trace_headers=trace_headers,
+            priority=priority,
+        )
+        async for _ in generator:
+            pass
